name: Nathanael
role: Disciple of Jesus, named as a model of guilelessness
dateNote: Section 41, dated 4 February 1831, compares Edward Partridge to him.
importance: Nathanael is a disciple of Jesus in the Gospel of John. Section 41 calls Edward Partridge to be bishop. The revelation says this is because Partridge’s heart is pure, “like unto Nathanael of old, in whom there is no guile.”
connections: He is named only as a comparison for Edward Partridge.
reviewNote: Checked D&C 41:9–11 on the official page. Described only as the revelation presents him.
